name: tools-smw-multitools-launcher
title: SMW MultiTools Launcher v2.28s
description:
Improve your creativity and productivity by forgetting the annoying management of all the tools you need by centralizing all your tools and other frequently used files in one place!

Link your tools to SMWMTL and when you need it, just one click and your tool is started, saving you valuable time searching for it in your folders and stay focused on what you want to do!

SMWMTL is lightweight and customizable to fit every use, whether you're a beginner or advanced.

--

Minimal System Requirements:
OS : Windows Vista (Service Pack 2, 64-bit)
.NET Framework : Version 4.6

Recommended System Requirements:
OS : Windows 7 (Service Pack 1, 64-bit)
.NET Framework : Version 4.8 (Version 4.8.1 is compatible for Windows 10 20H2+ and Windows 11.)
